
#General equation for the model:
#Yi∣mi,di,Si∼Pois(miλi)

#Spatial Poisson regression with a Leroux CAR random effect:
#Yi∼Poisson(Eiλi) (Distribution of observed stillbirth counts)
#log(λi)=β0+β1(IMD_ranki)+β2(Ethnic Minority Percentagei)+ui (How the risk of stillbirth is estimated using ethnicity, deprivation and spatial effects)

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)

lad_model <- lad_data %>%
  left_join(final, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  rename(
    stillbirths = stillbirths.x,
    births = births.x,
    IMD_rank = IMD_rank.x,
    ethnic_minority_pct = ethnic_minority_pct.x
  )


# Scale predictors
lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  mutate(
    IMD_rank_scaled = as.numeric(scale(IMD_rank)),
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled = as.numeric(scale(ethnic_minority_pct))
  )


# England model data
england_sf <- lad_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(IMD_rank_scaled),
    !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct_scaled),
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(births),
    births > 0,
    str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  )

england_sf <- england_sf[card(poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)) > 0, ]

england_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

england_nb <- poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)

england_W <- listw2mat(nb2listw(england_nb, style = "B"))
england_W <- (england_W + t(england_W)) / 2
england_W <- ifelse(england_W > 0, 1, 0)


england_model <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~ IMD_rank_scaled +
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled +
    offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = england_data,
  W = england_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000
)


# Regression coefficients and confidence intervals
england_results <- england_model$summary.results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = rownames(.),
    model = "England"
  )


beta_results <- england_results


# Spatial correlation parameter
spatial_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  spatial_correlation = england_model$summary.results["rho", "Mean"]
)


# Unexplained spatial variance
england_variance <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  unexplained_variance = var(as.vector(england_model$samples$phi))
)

variance_results <- england_variance


# Combine results
CARBayes_results <- list(
  regression_coefficients = beta_results,
  spatial_correlation = spatial_results,
  unexplained_variance = variance_results
)


write_xlsx(
  CARBayes_results,
  file.path(folder, "CARBayes_model_results.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(spdep)
library(writexl)

n <- nrow(england_sf)

observed <- england_data$stillbirths
predicted <- numeric(n)

for(i in 1:n){

  message("Running LAD ", i, " of ", n)

  # Remove left-out LAD
  train_sf <- england_sf[-i, ]
  train_data <- england_data[-i, ]

  # Create neighbours
  nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

  # Remove isolated areas
  keep <- card(nb_train) > 0

  train_sf <- train_sf[keep, ]
  train_data <- train_data[keep, ]

  # Recalculate neighbours
  nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

  # Spatial weights
  W_train <- listw2mat(
    nb2listw(
      nb_train,
      style = "B",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )
  )

  W_train <- (W_train + t(W_train)) / 2
  W_train <- ifelse(W_train > 0, 1, 0)

  # Fit full model
  model <- S.CARleroux(
    formula =
      stillbirths ~
      IMD_rank_scaled +
      ethnic_minority_pct_scaled +
      offset(log(births)),
    family = "poisson",
    data = train_data,
    W = W_train,
    burnin = 10000,
    n.sample = 50000
  )

  # Posterior mean coefficients
  beta_mean <- apply(model$samples$beta, 2, mean)

  # Predict excluded LAD
  eta <-
    beta_mean[1] +
    beta_mean[2] * england_data$IMD_rank_scaled[i] +
    beta_mean[3] * england_data$ethnic_minority_pct_scaled[i] +
    log(england_data$births[i])

  predicted[i] <- exp(eta)
}

# Performance metrics

rmse <- sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2))

bias <- mean(predicted - observed)

results <- data.frame(
  LAD = england_data$LAD24CD,
  observed = observed,
  predicted = predicted,
  error = predicted - observed
)

print(paste("RMSE =", rmse))
print(paste("Bias =", bias))

write_xlsx(
  list(
    predictions = results,
    validation = data.frame(
      RMSE = rmse,
      Bias = bias
    )
  ),
  file.path(folder, "LOOCV_full_model.xlsx")
)
```
